claims.claim: Origen of Alexandria lived circa 185–254 CE and was a Christian theologian who headed the Catechetical School of Alexandria.
Scholars date the original preaching of the Numbers homilies to a three‑year liturgical cycle sometime between about 238 and 244 CE.
A Latin translation of Origen’s Numbers homilies was undertaken by Rufinus at the request of his brother Donatus during a time of barbarian threat, and completed when a quiet night allowed work.
The Latin version, based on Baehren’s critical text, is the basis for modern English editions of the homilies.
The Homilies on Numbers are valuable because they constitute the oldest surviving corpus of Christian sermons and shaped biblical exegesis for succeeding centuries.
